name: Òrrius (Spain)
description: Light blue field with a white saltire throughout and two yellow palm fronds, one near the hoist and one near the fly.
history: The flag was approved on 16 March 2005 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 4366 of 19 April 2005; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, light blue, with a white saltire throughout 1/8 of the height thick and two yellow palms each half the height, one centred at 1/16 from the hoist and the other at 1/16 from the fly.

features.role: two palm fronds, half the height, centred at 1/16 from the hoist and fly edges
